spec_raw: Remove hover effects on cards for classic and connect themes

spec_refined.title: Card: remove hover effects in classic and connect themes
spec_refined.description: Cards currently show a hover effect (elevation/background change) in the classic and connect themes. Per updated design guidance, cards are not interactive surfaces in these themes and must not respond to hover.
acceptance_criteria: In classic light/dark themes, hovering a modus-wc-card produces no visual change (no shadow, background, or border change)
In connect light/dark themes, hovering a modus-wc-card produces no visual change
The modern theme hover behavior is unchanged
Existing card unit tests and snapshots pass (updated snapshots only where hover styles were removed)
spec_refined.technical_notes: Hover styles originate in modus-wc-card.scss / modus-wc-card.tailwind.ts; themes are selected via data-theme attributes.
